# BADGER app source inventory

Source: inspected event badge's `apps/` tree on the BADGER USB volume.
This is a file-list snapshot, not a required app set. See `sources.md` and
refresh with the inventory command in `SKILL.md` for another badge.
Refreshed October 16, 2026; includes local test apps, not only factory apps.
